sections.title: Valuation Insights
sections.text: Visa delivered a revenue base of [[V.fact.revenue]] with year‑over‑year growth of [[V.ratio.revenue_growth]] in constant‑dollar terms. The operating margin of [[V.ratio.operating_margin]] reflects strong profitability, while the return on average equity of [[V.ratio.return_on_average_equity]] underscores efficient capital deployment. Debt‑to‑equity of [[V.ratio.debt_to_equity]] indicates a balanced financing profile, and free cash flow of [[V.ratio.free_cash_flow]] demonstrates robust cash generation after capital expenditures of [[V.fact.capex]]. The GAAP diluted EPS of [[V.fact.diluted_eps]] pertains to the Class A common share class, and the price‑earnings multiple of [[V.ratio.price_earnings]] is based on the close price of [[V.price]] dated 2026‑10‑27.

insight.text: Free cash flow of [[V.ratio.free_cash_flow]] highlights Visa’s capacity to fund share repurchases, dividends, and strategic investments without relying on external financing.
